title: Floral carpet (dark red ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark red ground). 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1922. inv. no 197 (3910) from the Mosque of Vize Chelebi, Edirne, Turkey. 205 x 224 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 83.
